name: Neko
source:
A cast member who was adopted by her nasty step-parents and is now old enough to be sold off. She is a naive girl who believes that the club is a normal club with high exposure and a good rate. She is unaware of the existence of the back menu because the restaurant does not explicitly force it on her. She is fed up with the high prices and the high amount of skinship. As a result, although she looks good, she is isolated as an "inedible girl," but she is not sure what to do about it. She has a very strong personality.

[From [url=https://miconisomi.xii.jp/io/chara.html]Miconisomi[/url]]
